Name: Recyclable Joja Cola
Author: OrangeGamingSystem
Description:
This mod allows you to put Joja Cola in a Recycling Machine to get iron ore, and (more rarely) coffee or sugar.

The exact probability is shown below:
[spoiler]40% - 1 Iron Ore
20% - 2 Iron Ore
20% - 3 Iron Ore
10% - 1 Coffee
10% - 1 Sugar[/spoiler]
This mod ensures that, on average, you will lose money when recycling purchased Joja Cola, even if you smelt Iron Ore with the Blacksmith profession.

This mod only requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.

Installation is the same as like every other mod, unzip the downloaded file and place it in your Mods folder.
